messages:
Talia Benson: Weekly xfn update on AWS/GCP Marketplace refresh. Posting here so everyone has the same view of status + blockers + deadlines. Please reply in-thread w/ deltas by EOD.

Talia Benson: 
Status (this week)
• SKUs: v2 naming + entitlement IDs locked in ADR; Eng implementing mapping + billing plan codes.
• AWS listing: copy in final pass, screenshot set mostly ready, security packet nearing sign-off.
• GCP listing: structure + FAQ updated per reviewer notes; still some validation quirks to iron out.
• Onboarding: purchase→entitlement→org linking wizard in staging; E2E tests running; SRE dashboards drafted.

Upcoming deadlines
• AWS: partner submission target = Wed 2/12 12pm PT (so we can get into next review queue)
• GCP: resubmission target = Fri 2/14 3pm PT (after we address validation + policy link requirements)

Current blockers
1) Security language final approvals (SOC2 handling + audit logging wording)
2) Final screenshot redaction approvals (console entitlement state screens)
3) GCP region mismatch edge case fix (causing validation error in reviewer environment)

Owners: pls confirm below + flag anything slipping.

Soojin Lee: AWS copy is 95%. Need final confirmation on 2 bullets that mention “audit logs” and “customer-managed keys” so we don’t over-claim. Dropping the diff here: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/internal/marketplace/aws-copy-diff (internal link).

Marcus Lin: On audit logs language: ok to say “audit logs available for admin actions and provisioning events” but NOT “all customer actions” or “every request” etc. Also re: KMS: say “supports KMS integrations for Private/VPC deployments; Hosted uses envelope encryption with cloud-managed keys” (unless we explicitly support CMK for Hosted in these SKUs). Please keep it tight.

Olga Petrov: +1. Also reminder: SOC 2 report itself can’t be attached in marketplace listing. We can include the “SOC 2 Type II available under NDA” statement + link to request form. I updated evidence index last night.

Elliot Price: Docs status: AWS + GCP marketplace onboarding pages are in review, but I need final SKU names (exact casing) to avoid docs + listing mismatch. Also want to align the “upgrade/downgrade” FAQ text with PM decision.

Lauren Bishop: SKU casing is final per ADR: 
• Redwood Hosted API
• Redwood Dedicated
• Redwood Private
Add-ons: Compliance Pack, Observability Retention, Premium SLA (where applicable). I’ll DM you the exact strings we’re using in Console.

Vivek Kulkarni: For Private: please ensure copy does not imply “on-prem included” in marketplace SKU. Marketplace SKU is VPC/private control plane; on-prem is separate enterprise engagement.

Connor O'Brien: Release/readiness: if AWS submit is Wed noon, we need final attachments (security packet PDF + screenshot set) in the partner portal by Wed 10am PT. Can we get a “green” from Security by Tue EOD?

Camila Reyes: Marketing can hit AWS deadline *if* screenshots are final by Tue 2pm. If redaction isn’t done, we’ll submit with older images but that’s suboptimal.

Chloe Martin: Console onboarding wizard: latest build in staging includes entitlement state UI + “Link org” flow. Known issue: if user has multiple AWS accounts, we sometimes show the wrong “suggested org.” Fix in progress (should be behind feature flag). Will update ETA.

Ethan Park: Entitlement mapping + webhook ingestion: AWS path looks good; GCP is the one with the region mismatch edge case. Root cause: GCP sends region string not matching our internal region enum (“us-east1” vs “us-central1” mapping rules). Patch is ready; waiting on review from Nadia.

Cole Summers: Billing: plan codes added for new SKUs; metering descriptions updated so invoices are readable. Still need Finance to confirm wording for “credits/discounts” constraints on marketplace invoices.

Laura Bennett: Finance: invoice description wording is ok, but we can’t represent “credits” as line-item discounts the same way we do direct. Need to keep “promotional credits” out of marketplace T&Cs. I’ll share the approved language snippet in this thread later today.

Rafael Mendes: SRE: dashboards are in place in staging for webhook failures + entitlement lag + provisioning error rate. Need confirmation on alert thresholds. Proposal:
• webhook validation failures > 5/min for 5m = page
• entitlement lag p95 > 10m for 15m = page
• provisioning error rate > 2% for 10m = ticket
Feedback welcome.

Allison Grant: Thresholds look reasonable; also adding a breakdown by cloud (AWS vs GCP) so we can isolate partner-side issues. If anyone has known “expected spikes” during launch hour, flag it.

Dev Patel: Support readiness: we’re drafting macros for (1) entitlement delayed (2) wrong org (3) region mismatch (4) billing confusion. Need exact “where to send logs” instructions so customers don’t paste sensitive stuff into tickets.

Naomi Feldman: For “where to send logs”: we should direct to the secure upload link + request only request IDs + org slug, not full payloads. I’ll sync w/ Dev + Marcus and drop approved template.

Markus Klein: Field note: AEs keep asking for a single “what to buy” decision tree (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) tailored to marketplace. If we have a 1-pager, it’ll reduce churn in late-stage procurement convos.

Jordan Blake: Agree. Also: discounting constraints keep surprising prospects. We need consistent guidance: when to push direct contract vs marketplace (esp. for large commits + custom terms). Please add to enablement.

Ben Carter: Attribution/tracking: UTMs are ready for marketplace landing pages. Once listings go live, we’ll monitor:
• marketplace lead → org created
• org created → entitlement linked
• entitlement linked → first successful API call
Need Engineering to ensure we emit an event when entitlement activates.

Ethan Park: We have `marketplace.entitlement_activated` in the pipeline now (staging). Will confirm it lands in the analytics sink by tomorrow.

Leila Farouk: QA: E2E flows passing for AWS (purchase → webhook → console link) in our sandbox. GCP still failing on validation step when region mismatch triggers. Once Ethan’s patch is merged, we’ll rerun full suite.

Talia Benson: Action items / asks (please :thumbsup: on your item)
1) Security (Marcus/Olga/Aisha): final wording + evidence sharing disclaimers by Tue EOD
2) Screenshots (Camila/Soojin/Design): final redacted set by Tue 2pm PT
3) GCP region mismatch fix (Ethan/Chloe): merge by Wed 11am PT; QA rerun by Wed EOD
4) Docs SKU string alignment (Elliot): update docs + FAQ by Thu EOD
5) SRE alerts (Rafael/Allison): confirm thresholds + on-call escalation path before AWS submit

Talia Benson: Also flagging risk: if GCP resubmission slips past Fri, we’re likely looking at an additional review cycle delay. Please call out any dependency that might cause slip.

Soojin Lee: :thumbsup: on (2). We’ll push updated screenshots to the inventory doc and tag Marcus for a quick redaction scan.

Marcus Lin: :thumbsup: on (1). I can turn around the final language, but need confirmation from Eng on Hosted CMK support (so we don’t imply it).

Chloe Martin: Hosted CMK is not part of this release. Hosted uses cloud-managed keys; CMK is for Private. Please don’t promise CMK for Hosted.

Olga Petrov: :thumbsup: on (1). I’ll add the “available under NDA” language + the request process link, and make sure it’s consistent across AWS/GCP.

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: on (5). I’ll post the alert runbook link + escalation chain (SRE → Eng owner → Partnerships) once Connor confirms who’s primary during launch window.

Connor O'Brien: Launch primary: Rafael (SRE), Ethan (entitlements), Chloe (Console), Dev (Support triage). I’ll formalize in the launch brief + calendar hold.

Talia Benson: Great. I’ll post next update after Tue EOD approvals + screenshot lock. Keep replies coming if anything changes.
